title: Communication-Efficient Private Federated Reinforcement Learning with Post-Quantum Authentication for Vehicular Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated reinforcement learning supports cooperative vehicular routing without centralizing trajectory data, but model updates may reveal private information and incur communication overhead over intermittent vehicle-to-infrastructure links, particularly when post-quantum authentication is required. We study correlated private quantization, using complementary shared randomness between paired vehicles to reduce aggregation mean squared error while preserving the marginal parameter-level local differential privacy and one-bit communication cost of independent quantization. A tunable extension mixes shared and independent randomness to bound privacy leakage given paired outputs and shared-randomness side information. For this extension, R\'enyi differential privacy accounting establishes vector-level local differential privacy for one model upload even when pairings are revealed. translated_title: 面向车联网的通信高效隐私保护联邦强化学习与后量子认证
translated_abstract: 联邦强化学习能够在无需集中化轨迹数据的情况下支持协作式车辆路由，但模型更新可能泄露私有信息，并在间歇性的车与基础设施（V2I）链路上产生通信开销，尤其是在需要后量子认证时。我们研究了相关私有量化，利用配对车辆之间的互补共享随机性来降低聚合均方误差，同时保持独立量化所具备的边缘参数级局部差分隐私和一比特通信成本。一种可调的扩展方法将共享随机性与独立随机性混合，在给定配对输出和共享随机性侧信息的情况下界定隐私泄露。针对该扩展，Rényi差分隐私核算证明即使配对关系被公开，单次模型上传仍可实现向量级局部差分隐私。在匹配的向量级隐私和相同的本地……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用配对车辆间共享随机性的相关私有量化方法，在保持一比特通信成本与参数级局部差分隐私的同时降低聚合均方误差，并通过Rényi差分隐私核算证明即使配对关系被公开仍可获得向量级隐私保护，从而实现车联网中通信高效且具备后量子认证能力的隐私联邦强化学习。
